parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number from which to start displaying the returned results. Default value: 1, which indicates that the display starts from page 1.

parameters.name: MachineRemark
parameters.description: The identification information of the server protected by the anti-ransomware policy to query. You can enter the IP address or instance ID of the server.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the anti-ransomware protection policy to query.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of backup policies on each page during paginated queries. Default value: 10, which indicates that each page contains 10 protection policies.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the anti-ransomware protection policy.

- **enabled**: The policy is manually enabled.

- **disabled**: The policy is manually disabled. After the policy is disabled, running backup tasks will stop.

- **closed**: The anti-ransomware capacity is exceeded, and the system disables the policy.
